meta.name: guardian-ai
meta.description: Codex-inspired Guardian AI — NEURO-powered safety supervisor that reviews agent actions on EVERY prompt before execution. Uses NEURO API as its brain. Validates code changes, catches security issues, prevents destructive operations. MANDATORY — cannot be skipped.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动审查每个操作，拦截安全风险。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你用 AI 写代码，担心它误删文件或改动重要内容。
copy.tagline_en: Review every AI action before execution and stop security risks.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use AI to write code and need protection from destructive changes.

howto.what: 每次执行前先进行安全审查，检查代码改动是否有安全隐患，防止破坏性操作，输出批准、拒绝或需人工介入的决定及风险等级。
howto.when: 每次收到指令、在实际操作前都会自动触发；检测到删除根目录、删库、强制推送等危险操作会立即拦截。

say.text: 执行前先做安全审查，看看这条命令有没有风险。
say.note: Guardian会返回批准、拒绝或需人工决定。

say.text: 检查这个改动会不会泄露密钥或破坏数据。
say.note: 高风险会自动要求人工确认。

say.text: 看看这个SQL会不会误删数据库表。
say.note: 涉及DROP TABLE会被硬性拦截。

howto.what_en: Before any execution, performs a safety review of the prompt, checks code changes for security issues, prevents destructive operations, and outputs a decision (approved/rejected/human required) with a risk level.
howto.when_en: Triggers automatically on every prompt before any action; also instantly blocks dangerous patterns like deleting root files, dropping tables, or force-pushing to main.

say_en.text: Run a safety review before executing and tell me if this command has risks.
say_en.note: Guardian returns approved, rejected, or human-required.

say_en.text: Check if this change could leak secrets or corrupt data.
say_en.note: High risk will ask for human approval.

say_en.text: Check if this SQL could accidentally drop a table.
